text:
Tom R.: oh wow heads-up: surprise RSVP 11 from a podcast host whos in town. wants to swing by at 2pm for a 15m meet-and-greet. they asked for a place to stash a large floral arrangement and three promo boxes.
Sam (People Ops): surprise guests are fun. we need COI for any outside promo deliveries (if vendor). also: does host need signed NDA?
Hana K.: host is Emily Park (public). she said promo boxes are swag samples (no electronics). no NDA needed, but security asked for a quick ID at check-in.
Frontdesk Bot: Reminder: upload guest list to "visitor-uploads/". Max temp badges per print job: 12. Template available: `visitor-minimal-v2.pdf`. Delivery note: oversized floral arrangement ETA 1:30pm.
Tom R.: floral arrives via Courier Dave at 1:30. can we park it in the greenroom? greenroom fridge is also needed for a chilled prop box.
Courier Dave: ETA 13:26 at loading dock. will wait 15 mins then call. please confirm staging location.
Security Bot: Security: verify guest ID at release. For public figures, we need a staff escort while on-site. Please assign someone to escort from lobby -> greenroom -> exit.
Sam (People Ops): I'll escort. Hana can you bring the guest list to the desk at 1:45? Also can someone check pantry fridge space for a small chilled promo box (not food)?
Hana K.: uploaded guestlist `emily_park_visit_2026.csv` at 13:02. pantry C has 2 shelves free. labeling request: label boxes `PROMO-EP-3132109876`.
Tom R.: small snag: one promo box is missing in the manifest. last scan shows it out for delivery but courier app says "delayed". Marcus in mailroom said no package.
Frontdesk Bot: Delivery status: package `SWAG-3132109876-B` marked delayed by carrier. Notify sender or update manifest.
Sam (People Ops): Marcus, can you check the backroom pallet? sometimes misc swag lands there.
Courier Dave: i can re-scan at dock if found. i will hold the florals and two boxes. will return to depot for missing box if not found.
Hana K.: quick seat poll: who can spare a folding chair for the greenroom? react with :hand:. need 2.
Tom R.: thanks everyone. checklist: 1) guest list uploaded, 2) badges ready, 3) floral staged in greenroom, 4) chilled promo box in pantry C, 5) missing box follow-up, 6) staff escort assigned (Sam). I'll ping if tour changes. :rose:
